response.markdown_report:
## Insights and directions

**Starting point.** (1) SASRec models ordered interactions through causal attention. Its final state need not isolate current intent. (2) Simulator judgments identify stale interests and broadly related recommendations as distinct failures. These motivate explicit recent-context modeling, although judgments from twenty users provide limited evidence. (3) Electronics has 14.95% sampled wrong ranks and a −0.4812 lower-decile margin. Embedding alignment scores near 0.54–0.56 do not establish collapse as their cause.

**Related work.** (1) gSASRec motivates multiple negatives and calibrated training [1]. Its results do not establish gains here. (2) LS4SRec separates historical and recent interests [2]. This supports testing a lightweight recent-context branch before graph machinery. (3) GLSRec pools directed transitions [3]. Such transitions indicate association, without establishing compatibility or complementary function.

## Framework

| Direction | Available evidence | Minimal intervention | Unresolved gap |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ranking objective | Training interactions | Multiple-negative loss | False negatives remain |
| Current intent | Ordered recent history | Learned recent-context gate | Satisfaction is unobserved |
| Collaborative transitions | Training-only item pairs | Directed transition residual | Association lacks relation labels |

## Candidate ideas and assessments

Scores are prospective judgments, not measured results. Each cell gives **score; positive / negative**. Difficulty: higher means harder.

| Idea | Originality | Potential | User alignment | Model alignment | Difficulty |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A: 128-negative sampled softmax [1] | 2; focused adaptation / established | 7; scalable / sampling-sensitive | 5; sharper ranking / ignores stale intent | 8; targets separation / margins insufficient | 3; simple / masking overhead |
| B: gated recent-context residual [2], with A | 4; compact combination / familiar components | 8; extensible / intent remains latent | 8; targets two failures / compatibility unverified | 8; learns discriminative context / gain uncertain | 4; small branch / predictor synchronization |
| C: smoothed directed transition residual [3] | 4; complementary signal / established graphs | 7; shares sparse evidence / noisy associations | 6; specific transitions / may reinforce redundancy | 7; additional ranking signal / popularity confounding | 6; sparse graph / preprocessing cost |

## Selected: B

At 0% progress, B balances feasibility and diagnostic relevance. Its recent branch targets **historical-interest persistence**; conditional fusion targets **broad associations outranking specific current interests**. Multiple-negative supervision targets Electronics’ weak sampled separation. These are hypotheses, not demonstrated improvements or verified compatibility reasoning.

For each causal position, mean-pool its last three nonpadding item embeddings. Compute `g = sigmoid(MLP([SASRec_state, recent_pool]))`; score candidates using `LayerNorm(SASRec_state + g * W(recent_pool))`. Train with one positive and 128 uniform negatives, excluding padding and known training positives. Compare baseline, objective-only A, then B under identical seeds and the pinned macro validation HR@10.

Retain all category models, routing, splits, environment data path, and trial-local artifacts. Synchronize the predictor writer and diagnostic score adapter; retain both required diagnosis entry points. Report measured margins and their definitions, without unavailable metadata. Respect the shared budget and 200-epoch environment default.

References: [1] [gSASRec](https://www.ijcai.org/proceedings/2024/0939.pdf); [2] [LS4SRec](https://doi.org/10.1145/3723173); [3] [GLSRec](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.datak.2026.102606).

idea.description: Add a learned recent-context residual to SASRec and train with 128 uniform negatives per supervised position. Pool the last three causal item embeddings, gate their projected contribution using the SASRec state, and use the fused representation for every training, diagnostic, and inference score.
idea.motivation: Explicit recent context addresses stale historical interests and broadly related recommendations displacing specific current matches. Multiple-negative supervision targets the observed weak positive–negative separation, especially in Electronics. Neither mechanism establishes product compatibility, satisfied needs, or causal intent.
idea.implementation_notes: First compare the unchanged baseline against an objective-only variant, then add the recent branch. Select exclusively by measured pinned four-category macro validation HR@10. Generate negatives using training histories only; mask padding and known training positives without inspecting held-out labels. Bound negative-scoring memory using chunks if needed. Preserve preprocessing seed 0, training seed 42, all dataset routing, DATA_DIR = os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'], trial-local artifacts, and the SASREC_EPOCHS environment default of 200. Save architecture configuration with checkpoints and update the predictor writer to instantiate the same model. Preserve DiagnosisProbe(view, device), run_full_diagnosis(train_loader), and diagnosis_interpreter_prompt(raw_diagnosis). Have log2feats expose the fused representation and predict_score use the actual trained scoring path. Do not infer unavailable categories, ratings, reviews, or simulator traits.
idea.pseudocode:
for category in four_categories:
    initialize category SASRec and recent-context gate with seed 42
    for batch in training_loader:
        h = SASRec.log2feats(sequence)
        r = causal_nonpadding_mean(item_emb(sequence), window=3)
        g = sigmoid(MLP(concat(h, r)))
        z = LayerNorm(h + g * project(r))
        negatives = uniform_sample_excluding_padding_and_training_positives(K=128)
        logits = score(z, concat(positive, negatives))
        loss = cross_entropy(logits[valid_positions], target_index=0)
        optimize(loss)
    evaluate_with_pinned_validation_protocol()
select_configuration_by_four_category_macro_HR_at_10()
write_matching_predictor_and_checkpoint_configuration()

originality.positive: A compact combination connects recent-context fusion with stronger sampled ranking supervision.
originality.negative: Recent-interest encoders, gates, residual fusion, and multiple-negative objectives are established techniques.

future_potential.positive: Provides a small, testable foundation for later temporal or candidate-conditioned intent modeling.
future_potential.negative: Interaction sequences cannot reliably identify compatibility, satisfaction, or intent switching, and benchmark gains remain unmeasured.

code_difficulty.positive: Requires a pooling operation, projection, gate, and loss change while retaining SASRec.
code_difficulty.negative: Negative masking, causal pooling, memory use, and consistent predictor and diagnostic serialization require care.

related_work.title: gSASRec
contributions: Addresses sampling-induced overconfidence with generalized binary cross-entropy.
Motivates testing substantially more sampled negatives.
limitations: Does not establish gains on this pinned benchmark.
Calibration does not correct false-negative labels; the proposed sampled-softmax variant is a separate adaptation.

related_work.title: LS4SRec
contributions: Combines separate long-term and short-term interest encoders with global transition information.
limitations: Does not isolate the effect of the proposed lightweight recent-context gate.
Does not establish compatibility or satisfied-need recognition.

related_work.title: GLSRec
contributions: Uses directed global transitions to inform item representations before local sequence modeling.
limitations: Transition association does not establish complementarity or substitutability.
Additional graph construction and propagation increase implementation and search costs.
